tickerText: [TENNIS] Round-of-16 Saturday at the China Open and Japan Open: Alexander Zverev meets wildcard Juncheng Shang after Cameron Norrie, Carlos Alcaraz defends in Tokyo against Matteo Arnaldi, and Daniil Medvedev faces Jan-Lennard Struff in Beijing • [SQUASH] Swedish Open semifinals hit the GIH glass court in Stockholm on Oct. 3 after Georgina Kennedy rallied from 0-2 to beat Rowan Elaraby and Amanda Sobhy, Nele Gilis, and Fayrouz Aboelkheir reached the women's last four • [BADMINTON] Malaysia's world No. 3 junior pair Redzuan-Isyraf head to Cairo for the BWF World Junior Championships team event starting Oct. 5, with the Super 500 Arctic Open in Vantaa following Oct. 6 • [PICKLEBALL] Pro semifinals at the Rate Las Vegas Open start Oct. 3 at noon PT on PickleballTV from Darling Tennis Center, with Anna Leigh Waters still two doubles titles shy of career No. 200 on the $1.06M Open • [TABLE TENNIS] Final China Smash qualifying day Oct. 3 at Shougang Park after Matteo Mutti upset Marcos Freitas in five games; eight men's and women's main-draw berths lock in before Sunday's round of 64

newsItems.title: Alcaraz, Zverev Lead R16 Saturday
newsItems.excerpt: Carlos Alcaraz faces Matteo Arnaldi and Denis Shapovalov meets Alejandro Tabilo as the Japan Open round of 16 wraps Oct. 3, while Beijing's China Open has Alexander Zverev vs. Juncheng Shang and Daniil Medvedev vs. Jan-Lennard Struff among the ATP 500 highlights.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Hits Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open moves to pro semifinals on Oct. 3 at Darling Tennis Center (noon PT, PickleballTV), with Anna Leigh Waters—skipping singles—still two doubles wins from career title No. 200 on the season's second 1,000-point Open.

newsItems.title: Mutti Stuns Freitas In Beijing
newsItems.excerpt: Matteo Mutti outlasted No. 12 seed Marcos Freitas 13-15, 11-8, 11-6, 9-11, 13-11 on the penultimate China Smash qualifying day Oct. 3, with final men's and women's qualifying rounds deciding the last eight main-draw spots before play opens Oct. 4.

newsItems.title: Juniors Eye Cairo Medals
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 3 boys' doubles Redzuan-Isyraf say they are fit and focused ahead of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo from Oct. 5, aiming to put Malaysia back on the podium after missing out in Guwahati last year.
